[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/[\d\.]+:\d{5}\/\?cmd=indexes/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/[\d\.]+\/odin\/c1\/(channel\/ads|skin\/config)\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/damang\.api\.mgtv\.com\/station\/album\/red\/dot\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/hb-boom\.api\.mgtv\.com\/release\/pullReleaseInfo/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mobile\.api\.mgtv\.com\/v2\/mobile\/checkUpdate\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mobileso\.bz\.mgtv\.com\/spotlight\/search\/v1\?/i then reject_dict(200)
